draft.subject: One small next step for Maple Partners
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

No pressure on my earlier notes 
dash I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm happy to set up that first project with you live and answer anything about how your team works.

Best,
Nadia
